content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","title":"Distance vs Displacement","quick":"Distance is the total path length you walk, no matter how much you turn. Displacement is the straight-line gap between start and end point, with direction.","full":"Imagine a child walks from home to the kirana shop, which is 100 m away, but the lane bends, so he actually walks 150 m along the road. Distance is the full 150 m he walked, counting every turn. Displacement is the straight 100 m gap between home and shop, in the direction from home to shop. If he buys sweets and walks back home the same way, his distance becomes 300 m (150+150), but his displacement becomes 0, because he is back where he started. Distance only adds up path length and is never negative or zero unless you don't move. Displacement depends on direction and can be zero even after a lot of walking.","traps":["Thinking distance and displacement are always equal","Forgetting displacement can be zero when you return to start","Not mentioning that displacement needs direction, only a number is written"],"misconception":"Children think distance and displacement are just two names for the same thing, the length you walked.","parent_questions":[{"q":"If you walk to the temple and come straight back home by the same road, what is your displacement?","expected_answer_hint":"Zero, because start and end point are same, even though distance walked is not zero."},{"q":"Which one, distance or displacement, can never be less than the other?","expected_answer_hint":"Distance is always greater than or equal to displacement."}],"check_question":{"q":"Riya walks 60 m to the park along a straight road and comes back the same straight road to her house. What is her displacement?","options":["0 m","60 m","120 m"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct, she ends where she started, so displacement is zero even though she walked 120 m.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Displacement is the straight-line gap between start and end point. Since she returned home, start and end are same, so it is 0 m."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A child walking along a bending lane from a house to a small kirana shop and back, shown as a path on the ground.","labels":[{"text":"home","position":"left"},{"text":"shop","position":"right"},{"text":"path walked","position":"bottom"},{"text":"straight line","position":"top"}]}}
